text: {"517":{"about":["rustc_parse"],"refers":[],"why":"The normal parser preserves macro bodies and invocations for later processing."},"518":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"Macro expansion is implemented by the expansion crate using the preserved syntax."},"519":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"SyntaxExtension and its expansion behavior belong to rustc_expand, while TokenStream is an input type defined by rustc_ast."},"520":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"SyntaxExtensionKind is rustc_expand's representation of the supported expander signatures."},"521":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"This describes the SyntaxExtensionKind enum defined by rustc_expand."}}
